items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: When we came off the bandstand, he came over and he shook my hand and said you're quite a young man on that trombone.

ctx.x: Actually when you think about it, the only bands that were making money were Cab and Duke. Cab, Duke and Claude were the only three bands that were making any money. Louis, of course, was making money.
Another thing that I would like to emphasize, some incidents that happened with Trent when we were playing the Adolphus Hotel, that was naturally, of course, in '25. Paul Whiteman came--
I remember, you told me that. That we got on the first tape.
